name: Thonburi Run #2 2026
short_description: Thonburi Run #2 is on Sunday 20 December 2026 at Suan Luang Rama VIII Park in Bangkok, over 21 km, 10.5 km and 5 km on the Borommaratchachonnani elevated road.
ai_summary: Thonburi Run #2 (TH Run #2) is a charity road race on Sunday 20 December 2026, organised by Thonburi Hospital with support from Thonburi Healthcare Group, with proceeds going to the Siriraj Foundation. The course uses the Borommaratchachonnani elevated road, with the start and finish at Suan Luang Rama VIII Park at the Thonburi-side foot of the Rama VIII Bridge. The 21 km starts at 3.45am, the 10.5 km at 4.30am and the 5 km fun run at 4.40am.

core_facts.venue: Suan Luang Rama VIII Park (Thonburi side of the Rama VIII Bridge)

faqs.question: What time does Thonburi Run #2 start, and what is the cut-off?
faqs.answer: The 21 km half marathon starts at 3.45am with a 3 hour 15 minute cut-off, so runners must finish by 7.00am. The 10.5 km starts at 4.30am and the 5 km at 4.40am. The bag drop at Rama VIII Bridge opens at 2.30am.

faqs.question: How much is entry to Thonburi Run #2?
faqs.answer: The race.thai.run page lists the 21 km at THB 850 and both the 10 km and 5 km at THB 650. The 5 km is a walk-run with no results. The half marathon has age groups of 20-39, 40-59 and 60 and over.
